title: Was Randy shown alien technology as a reverse-engineering litmus test

tellings.quote: was Randy shown this technology as a weapons expert to see if he could figure it out reverse engineer it on the spot as a litmus test to see how an exposed adversary might react

plain: Michels wonders whether a weapons expert named Randy Anderson, who says he saw alien technology on a US military base, was shown it on purpose, as a test of whether he could "reverse engineer it on the spot". Reverse engineering means taking apart a finished object to work out how it was made. Michels offers this as his own theory in his episode with Anderson: the idea is that officials may have wanted to see how a foreign adversary who got hold of the technology might react to it.
